description: Convert 2 to 4 source booking codes synchronously across all or selected target bookmakers in one batch (each slip's own source bookmaker is automatically excluded from its targets). Costs 2 credits per successful (code, target) pair; failed pairs cost 0 credits. For 5 to 20 source codes, use mbc_manage_jobs_and_history with action='create_job' and kind='convert'.

codes.description: 2 to 4 source slips to bulk convert.

include_card.description: Set true to render a combined 1080x1920 PNG share card containing all slips.

targets.description: Optional target bookmaker keys. Omit to convert each slip to all eligible bookmakers.

name: mbc_bulk_convert
title: Bulk Convert Multiple Bet Codes
